title: The docs live at the root of DOCS_ORIGIN: /docs/* on Tracy's own hostname and the API host is a 302 there, a customer site's /docs is untouched, the docs host opens only its allowlist with no cookie in or out, Scalar there calls API_ORIGIN, and /v1 answers CORS for the docs origin alone
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run the command in `run.cmd`.
S2: Read the result of each test named in `run.tests`.
expect: Every test named in run.tests reports ok.

selectors.function: apps/tracy-web/src/config.js readDocsOrigin; lib/docs-host.js isDocsHost; bar/route.js hostKind; docs/route.js docsHostRoutes, docsRedirects, docsLocation; api-reference/route.js docsReferenceRoutes; app.js docsCors; apps/tracy-docs/sidebar.mjs
selectors.test: apps/tracy-web/test/docs-host.test.mjs, docs-route.test.mjs, api-host.test.mjs, api-reference-route.test.mjs, config.test.mjs; apps/tracy-docs/test/sidebar.test.mjs

fence: The docs host is its own kind before the site-domain loop and its own gate before customer-site routing; the /docs redirect is mounted after site routing, so a customer hostname never reaches it; CORS headers are written only when Origin equals DOCS_ORIGIN and the path is /v1, never allow-credentials. No network, no database.

tests: hostKind: the docs host is its own kind, before the site-domain loop
docs host: the site is served at the root, with its pages and assets
docs host: Tracy’s own doors are 404 NOT_ON_THIS_HOST, uncacheable, whatever the method
docs host: a signed-in cookie changes nothing and no answer sets one
docsLocation: the site loses its /docs prefix; the reference moved to /api/reference/
Tracy’s own hostname: every /docs… address is a 302 to the docs host, query kept, uncacheable
API host: pages go to the docs host; the three published documents stay where they were
a customer site’s own /docs is never redirected
API host: a preflight from the docs origin to /v1 is allowed — a key in Authorization, no credentials
API host: the answer to the docs origin carries its CORS headers; any other origin gets none
API host: CORS is opened for /v1 alone, and only where a docs host is configured
the page may call the API host and nothing else: connect-src names it, scripts stay self
GET /api/openapi.json is the /v1 document with the API host as its server
buildApp: the docs host draws the reference; its document serves the API host
DOCS_ORIGIN: required once this deployment carries the built documentation site, by name
DOCS_ORIGIN: set, it is normalised and must name a hostname of its own
the site is built for the root of docs.tracy.ai
the sidebar reads Get started · Using Tracy · Desktop app · Changelog · For developers
every sidebar label is translated in every _sidebar.json
